haj.d: the fifth pillar of Islam is a pilgrimage to Mecca during the month of Dhu al-Hijja; at least once in a lifetime a Muslim is expected to make a religious journey to Mecca and the Kaaba

haji.d: an Arabic term of respect for someone who has made the pilgrimage to Mecca
